A 30-year-old man from Changhua City, Chunghua County, was admitted to hospital in early September because he had symptoms of a fever but the symptoms did not improve so he went back for emergency medical examination. After reporting and taking samples, on September 17, it was confirmed that he was infected with dengue fever and type I dengue virus was detected.
